verdict.rationale: Orrick Tech Studio offers self-service tools such as health checks, a Series A Ready tool and document generators. Nothing in the evidence says any of them use AI to produce insights or suggestions from a user's data. The GenAI Policy Builder drafts a policy governing employees' AI use, and the health checks are readiness assessments with no documented AI component, so neither delivers this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
